Your public service channel.

UNTV, formally known by two brands as UNTV News and Rescue and UNTV Public Service, is the flagship Philippine television network of the Progressive Broadcasting Corporation (PBC), together with Breakthrough and Milestones Productions International, Inc. (BMPI), the network's content provider and marketing arm.  UNTV is one of the most trusted and successful Philippine networks that guarantees wholesome and quality viewing experience. Devoted to sensible broadcasting, highlighting alternative and intelligent programs, UNTV acknowledges the role played by media in the enrichment of life, culture, thinking and identity of Filipinos around the world. Programs at UNTV are designed to reflect positive spirit and values, that adhereto safeguarding media freedom and responsibility to delivering free, responsible and responsive network.
